execute_iterable_in_worker: run _execute_iterable to process an iterable in a subprocess or subinterpreter worker with command and data queues
wait_for_worker_init: call _wait_for_init to block until the subprocess or subinterpreter worker finishes initialization within a timeout
enter_iteration_mode: use _enter_iteration_mode to send START_ITERATION command to the worker and wait for ITERATION_STARTED acknowledgement
iterate_results_from_queue: consume items yielded by _iterate_results that reads from the data queue and returns worker iteration results
drain_queue: call _drain to remove all remaining items from a multiprocessing or subinterpreter queue
